name: Inngest AgentKit
summary: TypeScript framework for multi-agent networks with shared typed state, code- or LLM-based routers, MCP tools and durable execution plus tracing on Inngest.
description: `npm i @inngest/agent-kit inngest` (inngest is a separate dependency since v0.9.0). Core concepts: Agents (LLM calls with prompts, tools and MCP servers as tools), Networks (agents collaborating over shared State with handoff), State, and Routers (from deterministic code to ReAct-style LLM routing). Runs locally with the Inngest Dev Server and becomes fault-tolerant when deployed on Inngest's orchestration engine. Latest release @inngest/agent-kit 0.13.2 (2025-11-13).
